$comment: Retention policy for the harness's own output. The vault accumulates one note per
day per surface — digests, meetings, monitoring snapshots — forever. Left alone the
live folders stop being scannable, which is the actual cost: a `## Recent` list with
This encodes the convention already in the vault: date-stamped notes older than the
cutoff move to a flat `<folder>/archive/`, and their links leave the index. Nothing
is deleted, ever. `harness archive` is a dry run unless given --apply.

digests.note: Daily standup/checkin files, plus dated variants like <date>-groom.md.

meetings.note: Agendas and notes. Archiving keeps prior-occurrence lookup working — prep-assess matches by title stem and reads the archive too.

monitoring.note: Dated production-health snapshots. Undated topical notes here are exempt by the no-date rule.

growth.note: Visibility audits and talk outlines stay live far longer — they are evidence for performance conversations. idp-tracker.md is exempt outright.

knowledge.note: Topical, not chronological. A two-year-old architecture note can be the most load-bearing file in the vault. Archive these by hand, or let `harness memory audit` flag staleness.

memory.note: Durable by definition. Curation belongs to `harness memory audit`, which surfaces candidates and never deletes.

rules: No YYYY-MM-DD prefix in the filename → exempt. Undated means topical, and topical means a human decides.
Today's date → never archived, whatever the cutoff.
Already inside an archive/ folder → skip.
Any note whose frontmatter carries `pinned: true` → exempt.

index.$comment: Archived notes' links are removed from index.md, matching the existing convention: the index lists what's live. An `<folder>/archive/index.md` is generated so archived notes stay reachable rather than orphaned.

not_archived.runs.jsonl: Read in full by `harness metrics` for all-time counts; rotating it would silently reset the observability baseline. It grows ~1 line per skill invocation — negligible.
not_archived.graph.json: Rebuilt wholesale by `harness graph build`. No history to retain.
not_archived.system.json: Overwritten on every `harness sync`. A snapshot, not a log.
not_archived.workspace/: Gitignored clones. Managed by `harness-workspace`, not retention.
